why: Russian Menaion Reader plate «09191»: church-month 09 = May, day 19, this folder's feast in all four calendars. The plate is titled «Патрикий»; the Russian Lives keep one Patrick on 19 May, the hieromartyr bishop of Prusa, which is this folder's Russian form «Патрикий Прусский (Брусский), Вифинский». It is the only plate the series carries for that day.
